description:
Recently sold properties (address, sale date and price only; no buyer or seller names) from official open
        data, the last 90 days each source has published: `area` = 'Manhattan', 'Brooklyn', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'Staten
        Island', 'Cook' / 'Chicago' or 'Philadelphia'; optional 5-digit `zip_code`. Includes the median price, counts by
        ZIP and the date the data runs through (NYC and Cook publish with a lag).
name: recent_sales
